messages.content: 你能計算我進行的科學實驗中空氣在恆壓下的熱容量嗎？我有一個容積為2.5立方公尺的容器，並能保持溫度在300開氏度。我將在更高的溫度350開氏度重複這個實驗，接下來在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗。我在所有這些實驗中都使用空氣。你能提供這三種不同條件下的熱容量嗎？

function.name: calc_heat_capacity
function.description: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using its temperature and volume. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3. This is a float type value.

gas.description: Type of gas, with air as default.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to calculate heat capacity at constant pressure of air given temperature and volume. They provide three experiments: 1) volume 2.5 m^3, temperature 300 K; 2) same volume 2.5 m^3, temperature 350 K; 3) volume 1.5 m^3, temperature 350 K? Wait they said "I will repeat the experiment at higher temperature 350 K" and "next at lower volume 1.5 m^3 repeat the experiment". So likely the third experiment is volume 1.5 m^3, temperature 350 K. But maybe they want 300 K at 1.5 m^3? The wording: "I will repeat this experiment at higher temperature 350 K. Next at lower volume 1.5 m^3 repeat the experiment." It implies first experiment: 2.5 m^3 at 300 K. Second: 2.5 m^3 at 350 K. Third: 1.5 m^3 at 350 K. So we need to compute heat capacity at constant pressure for each.

We need to use the function calc_heat_capacity. Provide arguments: temp, volume, gas default air. So we call function thrice.

We need to output results. The function returns any. We need to call it. Use the tool.
